Because the view fails to filter by request.user.company, any authenticated user can undelete, inspect, and reactivate confidential contracts, NDAs, and settlements soft-deleted by other corporate clients.

from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework import permissions, status
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from .models import LegalContract

class LegalContractRestoreView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request, contract_id):
        # Enforce that the soft-deleted contract belongs to the caller's company
        contract = get_object_or_404(
            LegalContract.deleted_objects,
            id=contract_id,
            company=request.user.company
        )

        contract.undelete()

        return Response({
            "id": contract.id,
            "title": contract.title,
            "counterparty": contract.counterparty_name,
            "restored": True
        })
